source_cards.title: Restore, Separate, Restore: A Modular Framework for Music Source Restoration
limited_findings: Stage 1 plus fixed Stage 2 changed aggregate test MMSNR 3.980->4.047, Zimtohrli 0.015->0.014, FAD 0.300->0.293.
Validation-selected Stage 3 experts transferred inconsistently; metrics disagree.
Unconditional all-stem Stage 3 aggregate MMSNR 4.047->3.972 is distinct from selected-final-system MMSNR 4.050.
No subjective evaluation was conducted in this work.
Bus-level processing is explicitly not modeled, so outputs are not exact original project stems.
limitations: distribution mismatch between validation and test

knowledge_cards.claim: Pre-separation mixture restoration is a controlled ablation candidate, not an automatic rule.
Validation selection by one metric did not guarantee transfer across the independent test collection or metrics.
Restored stems are clean-source surrogates and not replacements for project-owned raw tracks.
Release claims require live artifact verification; the advertised repository was empty.

candidate_rules.name: restoration_stems_shadow_evidence_only
candidate_rules.when: considering restored/separated stems from a mastered or degraded mixture
candidate_rules.change: keep outside production automation and compare only as alternate evidence against licensed/project-owned multitrack truth
candidate_rules.parameter_range_and_origin: no transferable preset; Stage 1 on/off only, from the paper ablation

experiments.material: project-owned multitrack excerpt with clean stems
experiments.A: fixed separator on frozen synthetically degraded mix
experiments.B: same separator preceded only by Stage-1 mixture restoration
experiments.loudness_matching: retain raw outputs; create separate ITU-R BS.1770-matched blind-listening copies
measurements: per-stem MMSNR or SI-SDR against true stems
experiments.success: at least two preregistered metrics improve and Dmitry prefers B in at least 2/3 blind repetitions, without protected regression
experiments.cancel: artifact/identity/phase damage, metric-listening disagreement, or hidden topology/configuration change
experiments.blocker: advertised author repository contains no code or models

rejected.reason: no permitted transcript and no independent content beyond existing DI/amp/distortion cards

references.note: No new legal multitrack retained; existing project-owned Pena material remains the validation substrate.

queue.note: next executable blind loudness-matched listener test
